name: Form.md prompt
description: Ask a Form.md workspace a question and watch it read pages before it writes a summary note.

intro.label: Intro after the name
intro.default: reads your pages and database rows like a teammate, then writes the answer as a summary note. One Go binary and one SQLite file, on your own machine.

styles.transition: border-color var(--dur) var(--ease-out), color var(--dur) var(--ease-out)

styles.background: linear-gradient(105deg, transparent 35%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 22%, transparent) 50%, transparent 65%)

attrs.aria-label: Ask your workspace. Get a note back.

styles.border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, transparent calc(var(--fw-v-fmd_done, 0) * 100%), var(--hue))

children.name: Answer part 1
children.text: Form.md ships as one Go binary with one SQLite file.

children.name: Answer part 2
children.text: Each page body is a CRDT the server applies itself,

children.name: Answer part 3
children.text: so an agent's edit merges into what a person is typing.

children.name: Answer part 4
children.text: Rows are pages, shown as seven views on one query engine.

children.name: Fine print
children.text: A scripted preview. Nothing is sent anywhere.

children.name: Caption
children.text: Opens and saves the files you already have

attrs.aria-label: Form.md opens and saves Markdown, HTML, CSV, ENEX, OPML, Word, Excel and PDF
